structure: one affine_range(32) over middle axis; full-width [128,7168] load -> fused nisa.activation(op=nl.silu) -> store; 2 live SBUF tiles (x_tile,y_tile); no inner free-dim loop; mask-free (128*32=4096=M, 7168=N exact)
notes: First correct fp32 kernel (phase 1). Fused nl.silu LUT is L2-accurate under the 2e-5 gate on all 5 seeds, so the correctness-first ladder did NOT descend (v2 sigmoid+multiply, v3 exp-exact never needed). HBM-bandwidth-bound (DMA=97%, HBMrd+HBMwr=234MB minimal traffic, Vec=1% zero extra passes) exactly as designed vs the baseline's 4-vector-pass/5-buffer shape. Beats baseline 3.398x, already below the plan's conservative 0.638ms HBM floor estimate (real HBM bw ~2x the 368GB/s figure). Phase-2 lever = DMA/compute overlap.

D1 k=2 multi-slice DMA batching (one [128,2*7168] contiguous load -> one fused nisa.activation(op=nl.silu) over 2*7168 free -> one store; separate x/y SBUF tiles; 16 iters over grouped middle axis). --fast screen 0.3350ms vs v1 --fast 0.3011ms => REGRESSED by ~11%. DMA active dropped 97%->85%: wider bursts mean fewer affine_range iterations, coarsening the compiler software-pipeline so DMA idles more (the plan's predicted batching-vs-pipeline tension). HBM stays exactly at 117+117MB floor (no extra traffic). Screen-loser -> not advanced to the full AC-8 promotion gate (AC-3 negative test: a variant that does not beat v1 in the screen is not promoted).

D1 k=3 multi-slice DMA batching with exact-divisor tail (10 full groups of 3 middle-axis slices + one explicit tail group of 2 slices; no mask, both shapes exact; separate x/y SBUF tiles 2*3*28KB=168KB/partition). --fast screen 0.7729ms vs v1 --fast 0.3011ms => REGRESSED ~2.6x. DMA active dropped 97%->71%. Monotone latency worsening across the sweep: k=1 0.3009ms/DMA97% -> k=2 0.3350ms/DMA85% -> k=3 0.7729ms/DMA71%. Wider bursts => fewer affine_range iterations => coarser software-pipeline => more DMA idle. HBM stays at 117+117MB floor. Screen-loser -> not advanced to full AC-8 gate (AC-3 negative test).

D1 k=4 multi-slice DMA batching (8 groups, no tail) with D3 in-place compute: nisa.activation writes back into x_tile (dst aliases data), so only ONE live [128,4,7168]=112KB/partition tile is needed -- separate x/y buffers would be 2*4*28KB=224KB > 208KB budget, so in-place is the SBUF enabler for k=4. AC-5 validation: in-place src==dst COMPILED with no fallback/legality warning; full 5-seed run PASSED (correct 1/1, exit code 0) at 0.3968 and 0.3971ms (two runs); --fast 0.3973ms; HBM stays exactly at 117+117MB floor; single live tile => no extra SBUF spills vs a separate-buffer variant. The undocumented src==dst aliasing for nisa.activation is thus empirically confirmed correct on this streaming elementwise op. PERFORMANCE: 0.3971ms vs v1 0.3009ms => REGRESSED (DMA 72% vs 97%). Sweep is monotone-best at k=1: k1 0.3009/DMA97 -> k2 0.3350/DMA85 -> k3 0.7729/DMA71 -> k4 0.3971/DMA72. Latency is NOT still decreasing at k=4, so the AC-3.1 empirical k in {5,6,7} probe condition ('iff k=4 monotone-best / still decreasing') is FALSE -> probe not triggered. Screen-loser -> not promoted (AC-3/AC-8 negative test).

D2 explicit ping-pong double-buffering: k=1 full-width [128,7168] tiling like v1, but a 2-deep SBUF load buffer with manual prefetch of slice i+1 while computing slice i, driven by nl.sequential_range (so the manual schedule is honored; overlap comes from async DMA). Prologue load (slice 0) + epilogue compute (last slice) keep every slice read EXACTLY once -> HBM at 117+117MB floor. --fast screen 0.5889ms vs v1 --fast 0.3011ms => REGRESSED ~2x. DMA is still 97% active and HBM at floor, but sequential_range forbids the compiler's aggressive loop software-pipelining that v1's nl.affine_range licenses, so the manual ping-pong is strictly WORSE, not better. This directly confirms AC-4's expectation: v1 already sits at the overlapped floor via the compiler's affine_range pipeline, so explicit ping-pong is redundant. Exactly ONE confirmation run per AC-4 (no re-tuning). Does not clear the AC-8 noise band -> not promoted; keep v1.

D4 (dge_mode / DMA descriptor mode) rejected WITHOUT spending an iteration. Premise confirmed: adapter/nkibench_case.py line 59 hardcodes NKIBENCH_COMPILER_FLAGS=['--disable-dge','--logical-nc-config=1'], so hardware DGE is already off globally -- nothing for a per-kernel dge_mode lever to toggle. The AC-6 conditional D4 run fires only if D1/D2 leave an UNEXPLAINED bubble; they do not (v1 is DMA=97% saturated on the 234.88MB floor; D1 k-sweep and D2 ping-pong both LOWERED DMA utilization / raised the bubble). No unexplained bubble -> no D4 run. See profile/silu_phase2_d4_d5_rejection.txt.

D5 (bf16 / any traffic reduction) rejected outright. fp32 in/out is mandated; 234.88MB (2*4096*7168*4B) is the read-once/write-once minimum for that contract; SiLU is a single elementwise pass with no reduction/reuse, so there is no dtype/fusion/recompute trick that removes traffic. A bf16 operand/intermediate/store anywhere also fails the 2e-5 rel-L2 gate (AC-1 negative test). This is exactly why no multiplicative phase-2 win exists. Recorded so phase 3 does not re-litigate. See profile/silu_phase2_d4_d5_rejection.txt.

D-B finer free-axis tiling s=2: split each 7168 middle slice into 2 exact 3584-wide chunks, driving one flat nl.affine_range(64) over the memory-identical (128,64,3584) reshape view (single deep pipeline, not 32 refilled depth-2 pipelines). --fast screen 0.3001ms vs same-session v1 A_med 0.3009ms (pre-declared Jf=0.0005) -> WIN (advanced under permissive DEC-1). DMA active 97->98%, Scl 34->36%, HBM exactly 117+117MB (scheduling lever, not traffic). burst 14KB/partition. correct 1/1 (fast seed 42). Reshape flat view compiled cleanly (no fallback/spill/legality warning). Not the sweep-best -> superseded by s=7; not independently promoted.

D-B finer free-axis tiling s=4: 4 exact 1792-wide chunks, one flat nl.affine_range(128) over (128,128,1792) reshape view (single deep pipeline). --fast screen 0.2981ms vs same-session v1 A_med 0.3009ms -> WIN. Monotone-improving sweep so far: s=1 0.3009 -> s=2 0.3001 -> s=4 0.2981 (opposite of phase-2's wider k-sweep regression). DMA 98%, Scl 39%, HBM 117+117MB floor. burst 7KB/partition. correct 1/1. Compiled cleanly. Superseded by s=7 (finer still better).

D-B finer free-axis tiling s=7: 7 exact 1024-wide chunks, one flat nl.affine_range(224) over the memory-identical (128,224,1024) reshape view (single deep 224-iteration pipeline; nested form confirmed equal-depth, see silu_v3_s7_nested). PROMOTED. --fast screen 0.2938ms = sweep-best and monotone-best. AC-5 interleaved full 5-seed gate: A(v1)=0.3007/0.3005/0.3004, B(s7)=0.2940/0.2940; J=0.0002, Abar=0.3005, Bbar=0.2940. All four promotion conditions hold: Bbar<Abar-J (0.2940<0.3003), both B<max(A)=0.3007, HBM at 117+117MB, full 5-seed PASS x2 (correct 1/1, fp32 in/out). 3.478x over baseline (v1 was 3.398x); ~2.2% latency win clears the ~0.0002ms same-session noise band -- an earned finer-pipeline win at the streaming roofline (AC-6). effBW 799.5GB/s (was 780.6 at s=1). burst 4KB/partition (=1024=2^10, the natural sub-block of 7168=2^10*7). The finer pipeline amortizes the ~3% fill/drain DMA bubble phase-2 identified over 224 steps instead of 32 -- the mirror-OPPOSITE of phase-2's WIDER k-batching, which coarsened the pipeline and regressed monotonically.

D-B s=8 BRACKET probe (AC-3.2/DEC-2): run because s=7 screened monotone-best (latency still decreasing at the finest divisor). 8 exact 896-wide chunks, one flat nl.affine_range(256) over (128,256,896) reshape view. --fast 0.3105ms -> REGRESSED vs both v1 (0.3009) and s=7 (0.2938): the latency-vs-s curve TURNS UP at s=8. DMA still 98%, Scl 44%, HBM 117+117MB floor, correct 1/1. burst 3.5KB/partition: below the 4KB (1024-elem=2^10) burst, DMA descriptor/issue overhead per byte overtakes the pipeline-depth benefit (effBW falls 799.5->756.5 GB/s while byte-traffic stays pinned). This BRACKETS the minimum at s=7 and STOPS the sweep (exactly one bracket probe past the monotone-best finest point; no unbounded chain of finer divisors).

AC-3.1 flat-vs-nested loop-form confirmation for the s=7 winner. Same 32*7=224 iteration space as the flat silu_v3_s7, but expressed as NESTED nl.affine_range(32) x nl.affine_range(7) over the original (128,32,7168) tensor (free-axis start c*1024 affine on the inner loop var), no reshape. --fast 0.2938ms == flat s=7 0.2938ms (delta 0.0000, << Jf=0.0005) -> BOTH forms pipeline equally deep as ONE 224-iteration loop; neither refills/drains per outer middle-axis step (AC-3.1 satisfied: the win is a property of the finer iteration space, not the flat expression). DMA 99%, Scl 45%, HBM 117+117MB floor, correct 1/1. Kept the FLAT form for promotion (AC-3.1-preferred, memory-explicit reshape view); nested recorded as within-noise-of-flat confirmation, not independently promoted.
